line: Institutional tokenization moves forward as regulatory pressure tightens in Europe and law enforcement makes a high-profile arrest in Turkey.
small_line: Written from Bitcoin +0.63% on the day, spot ETF net -82.4M USD (Oct 16, 2026), Fear & Greed 53 (neutral), funding +0.0046% per 8h (calm)

wire_top3.line: DTCC plans 25-security tokenization rollout on Canton and Besu, with tokens backed 1:1 by DTC-held securities and Stellar, Circle's Arc anticipated in 2027.
Turkish police arrested Hex founder Richard Heart and seized $7.15 million in cash and six cold wallets across 15 addresses.
French National Assembly passed a 2027 budget amendment by one vote to end tax deferral for crypto-to-stablecoin swaps, effective January 1.
